tools.name: aweber_list_accounts
tools.description: List the AWeber accounts this connection can access, with their ids. Start here to find an accountId. AWeber API: GET /accounts.

tools.name: aweber_get_account
tools.description: Get one AWeber account: its name, company and sign-up details. AWeber API: GET /accounts/{accountId}.

tools.name: aweber_list_lists
tools.description: List the subscriber lists in an AWeber account, with their subscriber counts. Use the list ids in the other tools. AWeber API: GET /accounts/{accountId}/lists.

tools.name: aweber_get_list
tools.description: Get one subscriber list: its name, total, unsubscribed and unconfirmed counts, and creation date. AWeber API: GET /accounts/{accountId}/lists/{listId}.

tools.name: aweber_list_custom_fields
tools.description: List the custom fields defined on one list. Their names are the keys for custom_fields in the subscriber tools. AWeber API: GET /accounts/{accountId}/lists/{listId}/custom_fields.

tools.name: aweber_list_tags
tools.description: List the tags used on one list. AWeber API: GET /accounts/{accountId}/lists/{listId}/tags.

tools.name: aweber_find_subscribers
tools.description: Find subscribers on one list by exact email, status, or subscribe date range. Matches are exact, not partial. AWeber API: GET /accounts/{accountId}/lists/{listId}/subscribers?ws.op=find.

tools.name: aweber_get_subscriber
tools.description: Get one subscriber by id: status, subscribe and unsubscribe dates, tags and custom field values. AWeber API: GET /accounts/{accountId}/lists/{listId}/subscribers/{subscriberId}.

tools.name: aweber_list_broadcasts
tools.description: List broadcasts on one list by status: draft (API-created drafts only), scheduled, or sent. Read only: nothing is sent. AWeber API: GET /accounts/{accountId}/lists/{listId}/broadcasts.

tools.name: aweber_list_campaigns
tools.description: List the follow-up ('f') and broadcast ('b') campaigns on one list, follow-ups first. Read only. AWeber API: GET /accounts/{accountId}/lists/{listId}/campaigns.

tools.name: aweber_add_subscriber
tools.description: Add ONE subscriber to a list. Only add an address whose owner asked to join this list; AWeber forbids bought, shared or scraped lists. An existing address returns HTTP 400 unless update_existing is true. AWeber API: POST /accounts/{accountId}/lists/{listId}/subscribers.

tools.name: aweber_update_subscriber
tools.description: Update ONE subscriber on a list, found by email: name, status (subscribed or unsubscribed), misc notes, tags to add or remove, or custom fields. Setting status to unsubscribed removes the address from sends. If custom_fields is sent, include every field that must keep its value. AWeber API: PATCH /a

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: aweber_find_subscribers, aweber_add_subscriber, aweber_update_subscriber · Public sink: aweber_find_subscribers, aweber_list_campaigns, aweber_add_subscriber, aweber_update_subscriber · Destructive: aweber_update_subscriber.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: aweber_find_subscribers, aweber_add_subscriber, aweber_update_subscriber · Public sink: aweber_find_subscribers, aweber_list_campaigns, aweber_add_subscriber, aweber_update_subscriber · Destructive: aweber_update_subscriber

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
